story.ended: The auto-fix agent stopped before fixing it. Open it to see why.
story.landed: The fix is in your workspace. Commit and push it: the next run on {branch} shows whether it worked.
story.needsYou: The auto-fix agent is waiting on you. Open it to answer.
story.proving: The fix is in. A new run on {branch} is checking it now.
story.ready: A fix is ready on the agent's branch. Open it to review and land it.
story.reported: Auto-fix is off, so no agent was sent. Start one, or fix it by hand.
story.unassigned: Auto-fix waits for the run to finish, so its agent gets every failure at once. Start one now to skip the wait.
story.waiting: The auto-fix agent is paused until its allowance comes back.
story.waits: {reason}: the auto-fix agent handed this back. Continue gives it more turns.
story.working: The auto-fix agent is on it. Every new failure on {branch} goes to the same agent until a run passes.
story.collecting: Some jobs failed on a newer run. Auto-fix is collecting the remaining results. Fix now to start sooner.
story.failedAgain: A newer run on {branch} has failed jobs. Fix now to start another attempt.
story.stalled: The fix is pushed, but nothing will run {workflows} again on its own. Its line above says how to measure it. | The fix is pushed, but nothing will run {workflows} again on their own. Each line above says how to measure it.
story.stalledUnnamed: The fix is pushed, but what failed has not passed again since. Only its own next run clears this.
story.outside: No commit fixes this. The fix agent says it needs you outside the repository: {step} Then re-run the failed workflow.

mainFailure.title: {branch} is failing
mainFailure.resolveDescription: Every workflow comes off this failure now and the fix agent is sent nothing more. A workflow that fails again opens it again.

blocker.cancelled: its newest run, at {sha}, was cancelled, so nothing measured it: re-run it below
blocker.scheduled: runs on a schedule, not on a push: its next run measures it
blocker.byHand: started by hand, not by a push: run it again to measure it
blocker.quiet: has not run since {when}; tracking stops by itself on {drop}
